summary.zh: 在左右两列序列间绘制查询与目标区间的对应关系。
summary.en: Draw correspondences between query and subject intervals in two sequence columns.

summary.zh: 将多条序列画成辐条并连接同源区间。
summary.en: Draw sequences as spokes and connect homologous intervals.

summary.zh: 在双轴上显示局部比对区间及方向。
summary.en: Show local alignment intervals and direction on two axes.

summary.zh: 组合来源明确的独立面板并连接对应区间。
summary.en: Compose source-backed panels and link corresponding intervals.

title.zh: 用 geom_track_col 绘制给定数值

summary.zh: 将已有数值映射到序列局部柱形轨道。
summary.en: Map supplied values to a sequence-local column track.

summary.zh: 将已计算的计数值作为数值映射到柱形轨道。
summary.en: Map precomputed count values to a column track.

title.zh: 按目标尺寸预览与导出
title.en: Preview and export at target size

summary.zh: 按目标尺寸预览，并使用 ggsave 保存图形。
summary.en: Preview at the intended size and save the plot with ggsave.

summary.zh: 为全部特征分道，再选择部分记录添加标签。
summary.en: Allocate lanes to all features and label a selected subset.

summary.zh: 登记完整参考表，再将观察表传给相应的特征图层。
summary.en: Register a complete reference and pass the observation table to its feature layer.

summary.zh: 查阅显示窗口所需的来源序列标识、区间边界和实例标识。
summary.en: Look up the source accession, coordinate bounds and instance ID needed by a display window.

queries: 参数格式与逐序列配置

summary.zh: 按序列名称、显示顺序或链指定支持的几何参数。
summary.en: Set supported geometry parameters by sequence name, display order or strand.
